title: A prefix the leader has already sent
request:
a four-entry log, a retransmitted prefix, then a genuinely conflicting entry

./your_program.sh raft-log
init [1,1,2,2]
append 2 1 1 0 [1,2]
log
append 2 2 1 0 [3]
log
note: Both appends pass the consistency check at index 1 and 2, and both overlap entries the follower already has. Only the second one disagrees about a term, and only it is allowed to truncate. Deleting from prev_index + 1 unconditionally would throw away indexes 3 and 4 on the first message, and they may already be committed.

title: A follower that is missing entries
request:
two appends the follower cannot accept: one past its end, one disagreeing

./your_program.sh raft-log
init [1,1]
append 3 5 2 0 [3]
append 3 2 9 0 [3]
note: The conflict index is what saves the leader from backing up one entry per round trip. Past the end it is the first index the follower lacks; on a term mismatch it is the first index of the run holding the wrong term, so the leader skips the whole term in one go.
